usage: The word '減肥' (gaam2 fei4) is commonly used as a verb meaning 'to lose weight'.
It can be used in various sentence structures, such as statements ('我想減肥' - I want to lose weight) or questions ('你點解要減肥？' - Why do you want to lose weight?).
'減肥' can be combined with time expressions to indicate when the action takes place, like '我而家開始減肥' (I am starting to lose weight now).
It is also used when talking about methods or reasons for losing weight, e.g., '飲少啲嘢可以幫助減肥' (Drinking less can help with losing weight).
When negated, it becomes '唔減肥', meaning 'not losing weight' or 'not dieting'.
